description: Image Description: The image displays a collection of wooden baseball bats arranged diagonally across a surface, partially overlapping one another. The bats are made of light-colored wood with visible grain patterns and have branding and inscriptions engraved on their barrels. One bat prominently features the "Louisville Slugger" logo along with the name "Adirondack" and model number "M900L."
